Case and point: I'm currently building a tool that on its own would not have much value, unless a whole ecosystem of tools exists around it. It would absolutely not exist without AI because it would not make economical sense to build the entire ecosystem ourselves. So we were stuck using other people's tools for a core business engine. With AI I singlehandedely built the entire ecosystem AND migrated the old sources to the new tools in 6 months. It still takes a lot of work, but I would have to spread it out over 10 years without AI: hence, it would just not be done. The world is just in the phase of wanting to shove AI into everything. Its not going to be like that for long. There will be space for places where using AI is imperative, and other will open up where using AI is nonsensical.
